title: validate_headers .expect() calls rely on cross-function call-order invariant
description: In post/validate_headers.rs, check_newsgroups, check_date, and check_message_id each call header_field.expect("presence checked above") relying on the caller having already called check_required_headers. This cross-function invariant is invisible to the type system: a future refactor that reorders or removes the required-headers check will produce a panic at article POST time rather than a compile error. The presence check should be encoded in the type (e.g. return the parsed values from check_required_headers, or use newtypes).
